title: Result of orch conformance
description: The rows of an engine conformance run (orch/conformance.py run) with the published tag of the catalogue, schema orch-conformance/v1 (no $schema). run checks the rows in this envelope before it returns them; orch conformance --json prints the rows alone, as before.

schema.description: Published tag of the conformance catalogue and its result.

rows.description: One row per scenario and binding, in catalogue order.

status.description: pass or fail (a covered scenario that ran), declared or n/a.

reason.description: Why declared or n/a; null for a covered scenario.

difference.description: One difference between the expectation and the outcome.
